description: [provider] Autocomplete job titles. Lookup positions (CompanyEnrich · People & contact data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE, and disproportionately useful because people search has no free count route: this shows you the real title strings in the index ('Chief Executive Officer & Co-Founder', 'Interim Chief Executive Officer') before you spend 2 credits per row on a `positionQuery` that may match nothing.

name: companyenrich_positions_autocomplete
